content.short: Composable Security provides professional smart contract security audits tailored to a project's needs.
content.description: Composable Security delivers smart contract audits for Solidity projects, augmented by threat modeling and security overviews that illuminate risk areas and mitigations. With more than six years in traditional security, the team has served international fintech clients and the largest bank in Poland. Their roster includes FujiDAO, Enjin, Tellor, DIVA, and Volmex Finance, with many clients returning for ongoing security partnerships. The firm tailors audit programs to project maturity, offers actionable remediation guidance, and helps teams strengthen code, architecture, and threat resilience.
